speaker: Doctor
text: Given your recent heart attack and the presence of bloody stools, I am concerned about a potential blockage in the blood supply to your intestines. REQUEST TEST: CT_Angiography_of_Abdomen_and_Pelvis

text: RESULTS: Evidence suggestive of reduced blood flow to the mesenteric arteries.
